input.free_text_description: This system is a distributed transactions platform that serves Admin, Candidate roles. The platform provides capabilities for inbound client, inbound channel handler, server connection listener. Secondary concerns include messaging functionality.

user_stories.story: As a Admin, I want to search and filter records, so that I can quickly find relevant information.
As a Admin, I want to interact with demo functionality, so that I can accomplish my demo-related tasks.
As a Admin, I want to use inbound client capabilities, so that I can perform essential business operations.
